image_alt: A whippet walks along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

text.facebook: The clocks have gone back, so many evening dog walks now happen in the dark. PDSA advises keeping your dog on the lead after dark, as there could be hidden hazards you can't see, and the RSPCA recommends reflective or LED gear for you and your dog. My tip: light up the dog, not just yourself. On unlit Forest lanes, a dark dog is almost invisible to drivers. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/walking-dogs-in-the-dark
